scripts.typecheck: go vet ./... && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.dist: npm run dist:arm64 && npm run dist:x64
scripts.dist:arm64: wails build -platform darwin/arm64 -clean && bash scripts/build-dmg.sh build/bin/DeskMux.app arm64
scripts.dist:x64: wails build -platform darwin/amd64 -clean && bash scripts/build-dmg.sh build/bin/DeskMux.app x64
